description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Raytheon develops defense systems and is hiring an Embedded Software Developer I for its Space and RF Sensors Software team. The role designs, codes, integrates, and tests real-time embedded software for radar, sensor, guidance, and fire control systems, contributing across the software development lifecycle.
Embedded Software Developer I developing, testing, and integrating real-time RF/radar sensing software across the software lifecycle

Responsibilities:
• Work on complex technical problems and collaborate to provide innovative solutions. Requires investigation and troubleshooting skills to assess issues and develop resolutions
• Work at all phases of the SW development lifecycle, including SW/HW integration, dependent on program phase
• Assist in the derivation of system and software requirements, architectural modeling, and technical analysis
• Design, code, unit test, integrate, and document real-time embedded software solutions with a focus on RF, radar modes and sensing capabilities
• Participate actively in software peer reviews, code inspections, and technical decision-making alongside multidisciplinary teams, including program leadership and customers
• Support program execution to ensure work products meet technical, cost, schedule, and quality baselines
• Follow established software development processes and practices to maintain software product integrity
• This position requires the eligibility to obtain a security clearance.  Except in rare circumstances, only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Active and existing security clearance required after day 1
• Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from accredited institution. Degree must be obtained by start date
• Experience developing, and testing or debugging software using C, C++, or similar object-oriented programming language
• Real time embedded software development experience
• Familiarity with computer scripting languages such as Python
• Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving experience
• Experience developing software in a team-based development environment with strong teamwork and communication skills
• Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects

Preferred:
• Knowledge of Software Development Processes and experience participating in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, implementation, and testing
• Experience working with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and automated build environments
• Familiarity with Scrum/Agile, DevSecOps, Git/GitLab
• Hands-on experience developing low-level device drivers or real-time embedded operating system (RTOS) applications
• Hands-on experience with hardware-software integration and embedded system testing
• Familiarity working with physical hardware
• Familiarity and practical application of fundamental data structures and algorithms
• Practical exposure to radar technologies, radar signal processing, or RF systems
• Experience with developing and integrating software for Radar systems
• Experience developing embedded software utilizing ADA, Rust or similar secure programming languages
• Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of cybersecurity principles
• Experience working on UNIX, Redhat Linux, Windows, VxWorks, Green Hills, Integrity or other Real Time Operating Systems
• Familiarity with Unified Modeling Language (UML)
• Experience developing low-level code for microcontrollers or platforms like Arduino or Raspberry Pi
• Familiarity with cryptographic algorithms (e.g., AES, RSA, ECC) and their application in software assurance
• Understanding of anti-tamper techniques and methods for protecting intellectual property and sensitive data
• Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and developing secure software systems
• Familiarity with static and dynamic code analysis tools, such as Coverity, Fortify, or SonarQube
